examples.chinese: 我要買蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi dàn.
examples.english: I want to buy eggs.

examples.chinese: 好啊，我們一起吃蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ā, wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo.
examples.english: Great, let’s eat the cake together.

examples.chinese: 我要買大蛋糕，不要買小蛋糕。

examples.chinese: 我想買一些花和一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yìxiē huā hé yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: I would like to buy her some flowers and a big cake.

examples.pinyin: A: Zhè zhǒng dàngāo hěn guì ma? B: Shì ā, zhè zhǒng dàngāo bù piányí.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

examples.chinese: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想要送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 我要到超級市場去買蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào chāojí shìchǎng qù mǎi dàn.
examples.english: I want to go to the supermarket to buy eggs.

examples.chinese: 爸爸很喜歡吃蛋糕，所以胖了三公斤。
examples.pinyin: Bàba hěn xǐhuān chī dàngāo, suǒyǐ pàng le sān gōngjīn.
examples.english: Dad really likes eating cake, so he has gained three kilograms.

examples.chinese: 好多人來這家店買蛋糕，他們的蛋糕一定很好吃吧？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo duō rén lái zhè jiā diàn mǎi dàngāo, tāmen de dàngāo yīdìng hěn hǎochī ba?
examples.english: Many people come to this shop to buy cakes; their cakes must be very delicious, right?

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣很多蛋糕和冰淇淋，這樣的甜點我都很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài hěn duō dàngāo hé bīngqílín, zhèyàng de tiándiǎn wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan.
examples.english: This restaurant sells many cakes and ice cream; I like desserts like this very much.

examples.chinese: 這個香蕉蛋糕不好看，但是很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngjiāo dàngāo bù hǎokàn, dànshì hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: This banana cake doesn't look good, but it's very tasty.

examples.chinese: 明天是老師的生日，我們要送他一個大蛋糕，給他過生日。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì lǎoshī de shēngrì, wǒmen yào sòng tā yī gè dà dàngāo, gěi tā guò shēngrì.
examples.english: Tomorrow is the teacher's birthday, we will give him a big cake to celebrate his birthday.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.
examples.english: Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age.

examples.chinese:
氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。
老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin:
Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn.
Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english:
The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs.
The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese:
一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。
「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin:
Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo.
“Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english:
Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high.
“Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.
examples.english: Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted.

items.wordHook: a 疋(roll) covers a 虫(insect) snug and warm → a hidden 蛋(egg).

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 我家有一隻貓、兩隻狗和三隻鳥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī māo, liǎng zhī gǒu hé sān zhī niǎo.
examples.english: I have a cat, two dogs, and three birds in my house.

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡小動物，想要有一隻小狗。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān xiǎo dòngwù, xiǎng yào yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
examples.english: She likes small animals very much and wants to have a little dog.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese:
我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。
颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī.
Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english:
Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house.
The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

items.wordHook: a 犭(dog) calls out a 句(sentence) aloud → a friendly 狗(dog).

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，大人、小孩都應該多注意身體。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ.
examples.english: Recently many people have colds; both adults and children should pay more attention to their health.

examples.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
examples.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

examples.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
examples.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，大家應該注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, dàjiā yīnggāi zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Recently many people have caught colds; everyone should pay attention to their body's health.

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 老師明天要考三十個中國字，我應該開始練習了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī míngtiān yào kǎo sānshí ge Zhōngguó zì, wǒ yīnggāi kāishǐ liànxí le.
examples.english: The teacher will test thirty Chinese characters tomorrow, so I should start practicing.

examples.chinese: 我不懂他的意思，不知道應該說什麼，所以有點兒緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng tā de yìsi, bù zhīdào yīnggāi shuō shénme, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: I don't understand what he means and don't know what I should say, so I am a bit nervous.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 對，我應該多注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: You are right. I should pay more attention to it.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese:
小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。
有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo.
Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english:
Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today.
Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese:
地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。
當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin:
Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng.
Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english:
During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury.
When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese:
沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。
不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin:
Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi.
Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english:
No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well.
Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese:
我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。
為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng.
Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english:
My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping.
For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.
examples.english: The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it.

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese:
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。
每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin:
Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de.
Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english:
The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money.
Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese:
每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。
導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin:
Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù.
Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english:
Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing.
The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese:
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。
每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin:
Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de.
Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english:
The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money.
Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: 為了給孩子幸福的生活，很多父母一輩子都努力地工作。王先生這輩子沒結婚，他希望下輩子會有機會。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gěi háizi xìngfú de shēnghuó, hěn duō fùmǔ yíbèizi dōu nǔlì de gōngzuò. Wáng xiānsheng zhè bèizi méi jiéhūn, tā xīwàng xià bèizi huì yǒu jīhuì.
examples.english: In order to give their children a happy life, many parents work hard their whole life. Mr. Wang hasn't married in this lifetime; he hopes he will have a chance in the next life.

examples.chinese: 陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng zài yīyuàn lǐ zháojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng bú dào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
examples.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 父母不能保護孩子一輩子，得讓他們自己經驗一些挫折，才能培養出堅強的性格。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù néng bǎohù háizi yībèizi, děi ràng tāmen zìjǐ jīngyàn yīxiē cuòzhé, cái néng péiyǎng chū jiānqiáng de xìnggé.
examples.english: Parents cannot protect their children for a lifetime; they must let them experience some frustrations themselves in order to cultivate a strong character.

examples.chinese:
我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。
與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì.
Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english:
My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters.
When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 他把存了半輩子的錢都拿去做生意，結果生意不成功，錢都沒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ cún le bànbèizi de qián dōu ná qù zuò shēngyì, jiéguǒ shēngyì bù chénggōng, qián dōu méi le.
examples.english: He took all the money he had saved for half his life to do business, but the business was unsuccessful, and all the money was gone.

examples.chinese: 有人花大半輩子的時間工作，陪親人的時間卻非常少。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén huā dàbàn bèizi de shíjiān gōngzuò, péi qīnrén de shíjiān què fēicháng shǎo.
examples.english: Some people spend more than half their lifetime working, yet the time they spend with their family is very little.

examples.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

examples.chinese: 王小姐失戀後，花了三年時間才把那個男的忘掉。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě shīliàn hòu, huā le sān nián shíjiān cái bǎ nàge nán de wàngdiào.
examples.english: After Ms. Wang was crossed in love, it took her three years to forget that man.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng Lǐ jiàoshòu lái yǎnjiǎng, nèiróng xiāngdāng jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōuhuò.
examples.english: The school invited Professor Li to give a lecture; the content was quite wonderful, which gave me a great harvest.

examples.chinese: 開學典禮時校長所演講的內容又短又精彩，讓我印象很深。
examples.pinyin: Kāixué diǎnlǐ shí xiàozhǎng suǒ yǎnjiǎng de nèiróng yòu duǎn yòu jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yìnxiàng hěn shēn.
examples.english: The content of the principal's speech at the opening ceremony was both short and wonderful; it left a deep impression on me.

examples.chinese: 為了保住勞工的福利，她到處去演講。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhù láogōng de fúlì, tā dàochù qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to protect laborers' welfare, she went everywhere to give speeches.

items.wordHook: Combining 演(perform) and 講(talk): 演講 means give a speech, to give a lecture, to perform.

examples.chinese: 公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de wǔcān shíjiān hěn duǎn, yīncǐ tóngshìmen zǒngshì chī de hěn gǎn.
examples.english: The company's lunch break is very short, so colleagues always eat in a hurry.

examples.chinese:
這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。
A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin:
Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí.
A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english:
This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel.
A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese:
我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。
A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le.
A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english:
I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese:
這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。
張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà.
Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english:
This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes.
Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese:
因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。
不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le.
Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english:
Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over.
Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 他太晚起床，趕快刷了牙就去上班了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài wǎn qǐchuáng, gǎnkuài shuā le yá jiù qù shàngbān le.
examples.english: He got up too late; he quickly brushed his teeth and then went to work.

examples.chinese: 因為我趕時間，所以得搭計程車去車站。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ gǎn shíjiān, suǒyǐ děi dā jìchéngchē qù chēzhàn.
examples.english: Because I am in a hurry, I have to take a taxi to the station.

examples.chinese: 這個活動不好玩，大家都希望趕快結束。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huódòng bù hǎowán, dàjiā dōu xīwàng gǎnkuài jiéshù.
examples.english: This activity isn't fun; everyone hopes it will end soon.

examples.chinese: A:你快點把衣服換好。還不出門，就趕不上飛機嘍？ B:好啦，我知道了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ kuài diǎn bǎ yīfu huàn hǎo. Hái bù chūmén, jiù gǎn bù shàng fēijī lou? B: Hǎo la, wǒ zhīdào le.
examples.english: A: Hurry up and get changed. If you don't leave now, you won't catch the plane, you know? B: Okay, I got it.

examples.chinese: 他在超市隨手買了瓶飲料，回家後才發現有效日期快到了，只好趕快喝完。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chāoshì suíshǒu mǎi le píng yǐnliào, huí jiā hòu cái fāxiàn yǒuxiào rìqī kuài dào le, zhǐhǎo gǎnkuài hē wán.
examples.english: He conveniently bought a bottle of drink at the supermarket, and only after getting home did he discover that the expiration date was almost up, so he had no choice but to hurry and finish drinking it.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 下午颱風就要來了，看樣子得趕快去超市買點兒食物。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ táifēng jiù yào lái le, kàn yàngzi děi gǎnkuài qù chāoshì mǎi diǎnr shíwù.
examples.english: The typhoon is coming this afternoon; it looks like we need to hurry to the supermarket to buy some food.

examples.chinese: 老闆為了感謝員工為公司付出這麼多，決定親手做菜請大家吃。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèile gǎnxiè yuángōng wèi gōngsī fùchū zhème duō, juédìng qīnshǒu zuò cài qǐng dàjiā chī.
examples.english: To thank the employees for contributing so much to the company, the boss decided to personally cook a meal and invite everyone to eat.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？ 學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: A：謝謝你。 B：不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ. B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you. B: You are welcome.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你？ B:不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ? B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you? B: You're welcome.

examples.chinese: 好，謝謝醫生。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie yīshēng.
examples.english: Okay, Thank you doctor.

examples.chinese: 謝謝，這是我去年的生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: Thanks, this is my birthday gift from last year.

examples.chinese: 找您七百八十五塊錢，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo nín qī bǎi bāshíwǔ kuài qián, xièxie.
examples.english: Here is your 785 dollars of change, thanks.

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

items.wordHook: a 言(speech) takes a 射(shoot) straight to the heart → 謝(thank).
a 口(mouth) shouts a question at a 馬(horse) → 嗎(question particle).
Workers pile 土(earth) into a wall to 成(complete) a fort → 城(city; town).
Repeating 大(big) twice for emphasis: 大大 means greatly.
A period (期) of days marked by stars (星) → that's the week.
Reassuring that 沒(gone) is any 什(mixed) serious matter 麼(particle) to worry about: 沒什麼 means nothing serious.
照相機 means camera: 照(take photo) + 相(image) + 機(machine) → a machine that takes your image.
Combining 角(angle) and 色(color): 角色 means role.
a 辶(movement) path takes the 卬(lofty) gate → friends 迎(welcome) you home.
A 里(village) gives 予(give) its fields; that open land is 野(field).
